product.name: PurrGuard Eco Litter Box
product.description: The PurrGuard Eco Litter Box offers a hygienic and odor‑controlled solution for cat owners. Designed with a low‑profile entrance to reduce dust, the box features a removable absorbent pad that can be replaced after each use. The outer shell is made from durable, recyclable plastic, while the inner lining is treated with a natural deodorizing agent that neutralizes smells without chemicals. A shallow tray holds up to 0.5 L of litter, and a built‑in waste compartment collects clumps for easy disposal. Its white finish blends with any décor, and the compact 40 cm size fits comfortably in apartments or homes with limited space.
